assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organizing principle of the cell is a genuinely new concept of molecular organisation, reducing membraneless compartments (P granules, nucleoli, stress granules) to phase behaviour, multivalency and interfacial physics. Its reach across cell biology, neurodegeneration and biomolecular condensate design is very broad, and it is a physical-chemistry idea that deserves recognition alongside synthesis.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne established the liquid nature of P granules in 2009; Rosen's multivalent-interaction work showed the phase-separation principle with purified components. Pappu and Mittag supply essential sequence-grammar and physical theory, so credit is crowded, and a three-person prize necessarily leaves out important contributors.
assessment.maturity: More than fifteen years of independent confirmation across many systems; the concept is well accepted and still maturing, which makes timing right, though the field is still debating the extent to which condensates are functional versus in vitro artefacts.
uncertainties: Debate over physiological relevance of in vitro droplets versus functional condensates in cells
Whether the prize should be framed as physical principle (Pappu, Mittag) or as cell biology; a fair three-way split is uncertain
I am recalling the history from memory and have not verified details of priority

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles made nucleic-acid medicines deliverable, and the COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and siRNA drugs depend on them. The discovery rests on lipid self-assembly, pKa-tuned ionizable lipids, and controlled formulation, which is soft-matter chemistry with immediate, very large impact.
assessment.attribution: Cullis, Hope, Madden and colleagues developed the early liposome and lipid-nanoparticle formulation and loading technology in Vancouver; MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer contributed lipid design and delivery. Attribution is the hardest issue, since the work was a long, distributed effort and the 2023 Medicine prize already honoured nucleoside modification, so a delivery prize must be clearly distinguished.
assessment.maturity: Clinical and commercial validation is overwhelming and independent, so the science is mature; recognition is timely given the pandemic-era impact.
uncertainties: Which individuals made the decisive ionizable-lipid contributions is contested and I cannot resolve it from the supplied text
Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize may make the committee cautious

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The energy-landscape and funnel view of protein folding resolved Levinthal's paradox with a general thermodynamic and statistical-mechanical picture, linking sequence, frustration and kinetics. It is a clear conceptual advance in physical chemistry that I find compelling and that shaped modern structure prediction and design thinking.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes, Onuchic, Bryngelson and Dill developed the theory, while Fersht gave decisive experimental mapping of folding transition states. A theory-centred trio of Wolynes, Onuchic and Dill is defensible, but Fersht's experimental role and Bryngelson's early joint work with Wolynes complicate fairness.
assessment.maturity: Decades of experimental and computational confirmation; the concept is fully absorbed in textbooks. Recognition is arguably late rather than premature, though the 2024 prize for protein structure prediction and design partly covered the neighbouring territory.
uncertainties: The 2024 Chemistry prize on protein design and structure prediction may reduce appetite for a folding-themed prize
Division of credit between theory and experiment (Fersht) is unresolved

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity via PROTACs and molecular glues created a new chemical modality that repurposes the ubiquitin-proteasome system to degrade targets considered undruggable. It is conceptually original, with growing clinical translation, and a clear example of chemistry changing pharmacology.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched the PROTAC concept (Sakamoto, Crews, Deshaies 2001); Ciulli contributed VHL ligands and structural mechanism; Handa, Ito and others uncovered the thalidomide-cereblon glue mechanism. Credit is split between the PROTAC and glue branches, so this is a compound discovery that makes a clean configuration difficult.
assessment.maturity: Clinical candidates are in late-stage trials but no approved PROTAC drug is certain; the concept is well confirmed, yet clinical validation is still maturing, so this is slightly early.
uncertainties: Whether PROTAC and molecular-glue branches should be recognised together
Clinical impact not yet fully demonstrated

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers took photovoltaics from a laboratory curiosity to high-efficiency devices in a few years, with striking defect tolerance and materials-chemistry tunability. The impact on solar-energy research is large and the chemistry of composition and crystallization is rich.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka reported the first perovskite-sensitised cell in 2009; Park and Grätzel's group produced the solid-state device in 2012 and Snaith the high-efficiency mesostructured and planar cells. Kanatzidis, Seok and Grätzel are also plausible, so any three-person selection is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Independent confirmation is extensive, but long-term stability and commercial deployment are unresolved, so recognition may be premature relative to technological maturity.
uncertainties: Stability and toxicity issues may delay commercial validation
Allocation among six credited names is highly disputed
Fundamental versus device contributions is difficult to separate

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Self-assembled monolayers of thiols on gold and soft lithography gave a general way to control surface chemistry and wetting at the molecular scale and to pattern soft matter; it underlies much of biointerface, sensor and microfluidic work. It is an interface and self-assembly concept that I judge as important and original.
assessment.attribution: Nuzzo and Allara reported the first alkanethiol-on-gold monolayers in 1983, Sagiv's earlier silane monolayers have priority claims, and Whitesides developed the field and soft lithography. Whitesides, Nuzzo and Allara is a defensible trio, with Sagiv and Xia as contested alternatives.
assessment.maturity: Very mature, with decades of independent use; recognition is late, which could be good or a sign that other fields have crowded it out.
uncertainties: Priority between Sagiv and Nuzzo/Allara is contested
The impact is technique-wide but diffuse, lacking a single decisive discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Covalent targeting of the KRAS G12C mutant opened a famously undruggable oncogene and produced approved drugs, a striking demonstration of chemical genetics and structure-guided covalent ligand design with a clear single-author conceptual line.
assessment.attribution: Shokat is a single credited name, which makes attribution clean. Drug development by others (Amgen, Mirati) built on his tethering discovery, but the decisive concept is his.
assessment.maturity: Approved sotorasib and adagrasib provide clinical validation, though durability of responses and resistance remain active issues; timing is reasonable.
uncertainties: A single-laureate prize may be considered narrow
Resistance to KRAS inhibitors could temper enthusiasm

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Long-range electron transfer through proteins showed through tunnelling-pathway and distance-dependence experiments that biological electron transfer is governed by physical-chemical principles, with relevance to respiration and photosynthesis. It is a clear physical-chemistry result of foundational significance.
assessment.attribution: Gray and Winkler are the two credited people, which makes configuration simple, though Marcus (already laureate in 1992) and Dutton, Beratan and Onuchic made major related contributions that are not in the credited list.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature with decades of confirmation; novelty is old, so timeliness is questionable given the Marcus theory prize.
uncertainties: Overlap with the earlier electron-transfer prize and omission of other key contributors
Gray's age and prior recognition may influence committee views
